findingDetails.title: A .skilled-only linked repository has no project-level automatic hook registrations
A Claude transcript row larger than the 256 KiB tail silently suppresses the nudge
killer spawn errors leave interactive runtimes armed without a retry trigger
timeout cleanup can disarm a newer armed record for the same handoff path
Cursor's command mirror does not expose the documented /speckit:handoff name
Packet-bound continuity save lacks an explicit stop branch on failure

focus: correctness/traceability: final adversarial re-check of all active findings, severity challenge, and checklist evidence

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Final adjudication spans five automatic runtimes, shared parser/state transitions, command-only entrypoints, and packet traceability.

blocked: live Cursor command-palette confirmation unavailable in this source-only review

searchLedger.hypothesis: A linked repository with only .skilled may still load all automatic callbacks.
searchLedger.invariant: Each runtime requires its project registration in the consumer repository.
searchLedger.rationale: README lists five sibling registration surfaces; the fixture creates only .skilled.

searchActions.queryOrPath: README runtime matrix and symlink fixture
searchActions.result: Wrapper discovery exists; project hook provisioning is absent.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A final assistant record larger than the default tail may be lost.
searchLedger.invariant: The latest complete usage row must remain parseable at threshold time.
searchLedger.rationale: Byte-tail slicing and first-partial-line discard can leave no assistant entry.

searchActions.queryOrPath: usage reader, nudge null path, and long-row test
searchActions.result: Partial final row is skipped; null usage returns without a nudge.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Killer spawn failure may leave an armed record without a supervisor.
searchLedger.invariant: An armed record must have a live killer or an explicit retryable state.
searchLedger.rationale: Arm precedes spawn; tests confirm both spawn-error paths leave it armed.

searchActions.queryOrPath: stop-arm spawn path and error tests
searchActions.result: Sync throw and async error are logged with no rollback or independent retry.

searchLedger.hypothesis: An old timeout may disarm a replacement that reuses its handoff path.
searchLedger.invariant: Stale finalizers must compare the exact record identity they observed.
searchLedger.rationale: Timeout checks path, unarm checks status/path, and pending records can arm while the old killer lock is live.

searchActions.queryOrPath: timeout finalizer, armable predicate, arm write, supersession test
searchActions.result: Different-path replacement is covered; same-path replacement has no identity comparison.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Cursor may not expose the README trigger for the flat command file.
searchLedger.invariant: A documented command trigger must resolve to an available command file.
searchLedger.rationale: README names /speckit:handoff; only mirror is speckit-handoff.md; official docs support the file-derived inference.

searchActions.queryOrPath: runtime matrix, mirror filename, official command docs
searchActions.result: Mismatch remains source-based; live palette check is direct confirmation.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A failed packet continuity save may not stop later prepare.
searchLedger.invariant: Fresh continuity should be confirmed before the receiver resumes a bound packet.
searchLedger.rationale: Command requires a prior save but has no explicit failure branch; the skill rule is conditional and template wording conflicts.

searchActions.queryOrPath: save step, prepare validation, skill rule, template wording
searchActions.result: Missing explicit stop branch retained at P2; universal mandatory-self-detection claim withdrawn.
